description:
Promote (copy) the Maven artifacts for 'commons-lang3' version 3.14.0 from the 'staging-libs-local' repository to the 'release-libs-local' repository. 

Starting state:
- 'staging-libs-local' contains 'commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar' and 'commons-lang3-3.14.0.pom' at the path 'org/apache/commons/commons-lang3/3.14.0/'.
- 'release-libs-local' is empty.

Goal:
Copy both the JAR and POM files to 'release-libs-local', ensuring they are stored at the exact same path structure: 'org/apache/commons/commons-lang3/3.14.0/'.

Method:
You may use the Artifactory UI (Tree Browser > Copy) or the REST API. Ensure the original artifacts remain in the staging repository (do not move/delete them).
